messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content:
Here are some engaging true or false questions designed to break the ice and help students get to know their new teacher.

1. I have traveled to more than five countries in my lifetime. True
2. My favorite food is pizza, which I eat at least once a week. 大好き
3. I played a musical instrument seriously during my childhood years here. False
4. I prefer watching movies over reading books when I have free time. 映画
5. I have a pet that requires daily feeding and regular walks. 猫
6. I enjoy hiking in the mountains more than swimming in the ocean. 山
7. I learned to cook complex meals from my grandmother’s handwritten recipe book. 料理
8. I have never broken a bone in my entire life so far. 骨折
9. I speak three languages fluently and use them in my daily work. 言語
10. I am afraid of heights and avoid standing on tall ladders. 高所
11. I collect vintage vinyl records and listen to classic rock music often. レコード
12. I run marathons every year to maintain my physical health and stamina. マラソン
13. I have written a novel that was published by a major publisher. 小説
14. I prefer working out in the morning rather than in the evening hours. 朝
15. I have visited the moon in my dreams but not in real life. 月
16. I am allergic to peanuts and must carry medication with me always. アレルギー
17. I love baking sourdough bread on weekends using my own homemade starter culture. パン
